descriptionHtml:
Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S14 Offline mid-dictation and at the moment of an AI step, then back online, in both contexts: message, text kept, nothing spinning forever, saved after reconnect

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 Offline / no network: a clear "no network" message; the dictation is kept and retried when the connection returns (OAT-03). (UAT EFS state 9; TFA-94745 state 9; TFA-92568 Eng 4)
  • U13 Nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost in any failure state. (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 3)
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection). (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 5)
  • U14 Every state works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android. (UAT EFS Expected Result; UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Standard fixture, chart open on the Encounter tab

When Type line one and wait for it to save; the harness takes the browser offline; type line two; tap Generate Note & Finish; open Ask AI and ask; type a pre-round line and tap Save Note; the harness brings the network back; tap Save Note once more (the message's next step); …

Then While offline a clear no-network message shows, it says the work saves when the connection returns, and every typed text stays on screen; each AI step tapped offline settles on a message within 20 s instead of spinning; after reconnect the message goes and after reload the typed text is on the server. No note is generated twice

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From U9/U13 and the state 9 row literally: offline checkpoints mustContain 'no network', the typed text and a next-step phrase about the connection returning; each AI step tapped offline (Generate, Ask, Save Note) mustContain its text and a message 20 s after the tap and mustNotContain its busy label ('Generating Note', 'Searching', 'Saving & Updating'); …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S14 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: EFS Empty & Failure States · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: EFS/S14

Offline mid-dictation and at the moment of an AI step, then back online, in both contexts: message, text kept, nothing spinning forever, saved after reconnect

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

Detail:

Hospital and Nursing Home; spec newspec-c/flt-efs-s14-offline-ai.spec.ts. Network cut = context.setOffline(true) plus the Convex socket closed and every reconnect refused until the cut ends (Chromium's offline emulation alone leaves an open WebSocket working). All model answers mocked at the socket; nothing reached it while offline. Judged 36/42: 3 checks fail in each context (h2–h4, n2–n4). Pass: the banner 'No network connection. What you dictate stays on this screen and saves when you’re back online; AI steps can be retried then.' appears a few seconds after the cut; both typed lines, the Ask question and the pre-round text stay on screen; after reconnect the banner goes (~3 s) and, after one more Save Note and a reload, both encounter lines and the pre-round typed offline are on screen and on the server; one note per chart (one generateNote call). Fail (U11, state 9): 20 s after each tap while offline the step is still on its busy label — 'Generating Note…', 'Searching…', 'Saving & Updating…' — with no message on the step (only the top banner); the Convex client queues the call and the app has no timeout. Recorded (Q2): after reconnect each queued step ran by itself — the note was generated and the chart jumped to Post-Round, the question was sent (its answer went to a closed sheet), the pre-round summary was processed. Note: had the socket still looked open when the step was tapped (a real drop the browser has not noticed yet), the call would instead fail after reconnect with 'Connection lost while action was in flight' (OAT-03/S16 shows that path); the spinner during the outage is the same either way.

Product issue: A physician who taps Generate Note & Finish, Ask AI or Save Note while the network is down sees that step's spinner ('Generating Note…', 'Searching…', 'Saving & Updating…') for the whole outage with no message on the step, only the top no-network banner. When the connection returns the step runs by itself: a note can be generated and the screen jumps to Post-Round without a new tap.

Evidence: 16 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: fault-offline. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
